description: A tennis-ball canister stands on the table in front, with a bright yellow tennis ball off to the right and a red lid nearby. The left hand holds the canister steady as the right hand reaches in to twist and lift off the red lid, then picks up the yellow tennis ball and pushes it down into the open canister; after that, the right hand brings the red lid back over the top to close it while the left hand continues stabilizing the canister.
